name: Photo2Skin
description: AI Minecraft tools: AI skins from a photo or prompt, AI builds, real-world maps, textures and more. Make and edit Minecraft skins from a photo or a description just by chatting, make builds for Java or Bedrock, turn real places into playable worlds, and search the free skin and builds libraries. OAuth sign-in with a free Photo2Skin account; browsing is free, creations spend the user's Photo2Skin credits and the server never buys anything.
